support.name: Zendesk AI
support.best: Growing support teams that want email, chat and AI agents in one mature help desk
support.price: Free 14-day trial; paid from $55/agent/mo (Suite Team, annual) or $69 monthly, USD; 5 AI resolutions/agent/mo included, extra $1.50-$2.00 each
notes: French agent UI and AI agents
No 3rd-party training; deletion schedules; no Canada region
support.rc: AI agent resolutions beyond the small included allowance are billed per resolution, so model the monthly cost before switching on automation.
support.canada: French UI available; AI regional hosting US/EU/UK/JP/AU but no Canadian region; USD billing.

support.name: Freshdesk Freddy AI
support.best: Budget-conscious SMEs wanting an easy ticketing desk with a bundled AI agent
support.price: Free 14-day trial; paid from $19/agent/mo (Growth, annual), USD; Freddy AI Copilot +$29/agent/mo (Pro+); AI Agent first 500 sessions free then $49/100
notes: Training opt-out by email; no Canada DC
support.rc: The low Growth price excludes Copilot and advanced AI; most teams end up on Pro plus add-ons, so compare the all-in per-agent cost.
support.canada: French interface; data centres US/EU/IN/AU/ME, none in Canada; USD billing.

support.name: Intercom Fin AI
support.best: Online businesses that want the strongest AI agent to resolve chats on its own
support.price: Trial available; seats from $29/seat/mo (Essential; $19 promo for new customers), USD; Fin $0.99 per outcome
notes: Fin answers in French; English-first UI
Fin uses help docs and sites
support.rc: Per-outcome Fin fees grow with volume, and US-hosted workspaces are used for model training until an admin opts out in settings.
support.canada: Hosting regions US/EU/AU only (EU/AU auto-excluded from training); no Canadian hosting; USD billing.

support.name: Tidio
support.best: Small Shopify or web shops wanting live chat plus an AI chatbot cheaply
support.price: Free plan (50 human chats/mo); paid from $33/mo (Starter, 50 AI+human conversations), USD; 7-day trial, no card
notes: Lyro answers in 50+ langs; English UI
support.rc: Pricing is by conversation volume, so a busy month can push you up a tier; check quotas before launching Lyro widely.
support.canada: Lyro handles French conversations; interface English; data location not published; USD billing.

support.name: Zoho Desk AI (Zia)
support.best: Price-sensitive SMEs, especially Zoho CRM users, that want Canadian data hosting
support.price: Free plan (3 agents, email ticketing); paid from about $14/agent/mo (Standard, annual), USD; Zia AI on Professional+; 15-day trial, no card
support.rc: Zia's generative features need Professional or higher, and setup has many options, so budget a few hours of configuration or a Zoho partner.
support.canada: Zoho runs Canadian data centres (Toronto/Montreal); French UI; CAD pricing available for Canadian accounts.

support.name: Hiver AI
support.best: Small teams that want to run support from their existing Gmail or Outlook inbox
support.price: Free 7-day trial; paid from $25/user/mo (Growth, annual) or $35 monthly, USD; min 2 seats
notes: No training; zero retention w/ LLMs
support.rc: Great for inbox-centric teams, but Shopify and CRM links need the Pro plan, which more than doubles the per-user price.
support.canada: Hosting regions not named publicly; ask Hiver about Canadian residency; USD billing.

fin.name: QuickBooks Online (Intuit Intelligence)
fin.best: Canadian SMEs wanting AI bookkeeping, receipt capture and GST/HST in one ledger
fin.price: 30-day free trial; from CAD $30/mo regular (EasyStart, AI included); Lite CAD $20; Plus CAD $110 (5 users); 90%-off promos
notes: Gmail/Outlook add-ins not confirmed for CA
fin.rc: AI agents categorize and reconcile well, but your accountant should still review sales-tax codes and month-end before relying on them.
fin.canada: CAD billing; French Canadian interface; CRA sales-tax filing support; promos end after 6 months.

fin.name: Xero (JAX + Hubdoc)
fin.best: Small firms on Xero who want bill and receipt capture included at no extra cost
fin.price: 30-day free trial; from CAD $25/mo (Starter, 5-bill limit); Standard CAD $60; Hubdoc included
fin.rc: Xero has no French interface, which can rule it out for Quebec staff, and Starter caps bills at 5 per month.
fin.canada: CAD billing; Canadian GST/HST/PST reports; English-only UI.

fin.name: Dext
fin.best: Bookkeepers and owners drowning in paper receipts and supplier bills
fin.price: 14-day trial, no card; from CAD $31.50/mo (Business, 250 docs, 5 users); AI Assist +CAD $15/mo
notes: Extracts tax; split codes need rules
fin.rc: Document caps and paid line-item extraction add up; Dext is most valuable when your bookkeeper already uses it.
fin.canada: CAD pricing; French Canada locale; AWS hosting, region not published.

fin.name: Float
fin.best: Canadian teams needing corporate cards, bill pay and AI receipt coding
fin.price: Free plan (Essentials, CAD $0); Professional CAD $10/user/mo (min CAD $100/mo), 90-day trial
notes: Own AWS models; training not stated
fin.rc: Free plan covers cards and receipts, but AI auto-coding of transactions needs the paid Professional plan.
fin.canada: Canadian company (Toronto); CAD cards and billing; bilingual support; Canadian tax recognition.

fin.name: Plooto
fin.best: Canadian SMEs automating bill payments and receivables synced to QuickBooks or Xero
fin.price: 30-day free trial (no card, 10 transactions); from $32/mo (Grow); Go $9/mo for accountant clients; currency not stated (likely CAD)
fin.rc: Plooto Capture is OCR-based rather than a full AI agent, so expect to review captured bills before approving payment.
fin.canada: Canadian company (Toronto); CAD and USD EFT payments; check per-transaction fees.

fin.name: Spellbook
fin.best: Firms with in-house counsel or outside lawyers who review contracts in Word
fin.price: 7-day free trial; custom pricing per user (quote only)
fin.rc: Built for lawyers; non-lawyer owners should use it to prepare questions for counsel, not to replace legal advice.
fin.canada: Canadian company (Toronto); data centres in Canada and US; SOC 2 Type II.

hr.name: Employment Hero (Humi)
hr.best: Canadian SMEs wanting payroll, HR and AI hiring in one bilingual platform
hr.rc: Strong for Canadian payroll compliance, but pricing is quote-only and implementation takes planning with their team.
hr.canada: Humi handles Quebec (RL-1, QPP/QPIP, CNESST); data in Canada, Australia, Ireland; CAD billing.

hr.name: BambooHR
hr.best: Growing SMEs wanting an easy HR system with hiring and onboarding
hr.price: From $10/employee/mo (Core), USD; flat $250/mo for 25 or fewer staff; demo-led
hr.rc: BambooHR payroll is US-only, so Canadian firms must link a separate payroll provider such as Wagepoint.
hr.canada: No Canadian payroll; French interface not confirmed; USD billing.

hr.name: Workable
hr.best: SMEs hiring regularly that need AI job posts and candidate screening
hr.price: 15-day free trial, no card; from $299/mo (Standard), USD; 3,000 AI credits included
hr.rc: Screening and sourcing agents consume AI credits, and a monthly fee this high only pays off if you hire several times a year.
hr.canada: Posts to Canadian job boards; data hosted outside Canada; USD billing.

hr.name: TestGorilla
hr.best: Screening applicants by skills instead of resumes
hr.price: Free plan (10 credits/mo, 5 tests); Assessments from $215/mo (Core, annual), USD
hr.rc: Good for ranking applicants fairly, but it does not write job posts, so pair it with an ATS or job board.
hr.canada: French tests available; USD billing; data location not stated.

hr.name: Synthesia (Training)
hr.best: Turning SOPs and slide decks into short AI-presenter training videos
hr.price: Free plan (watermark, 3-min videos); from $19/mo (Starter) or $14/mo yearly, USD
hr.rc: Creates videos, not a full training system; you still need an LMS or shared drive to assign and track completion.
hr.canada: French voices and translation; USD billing; hosting region not stated.

hr.name: TalentLMS
hr.best: SMEs building and tracking staff training courses with AI help
hr.price: Free plan (5 users, 10 courses); from $119/mo (Core, up to 100 users), USD; 20% off annual
hr.rc: AI credits are capped per plan, so heavy course generation on Core can run out quickly.
hr.canada: Translates courses to 40+ languages; USD billing; hosting region not stated.
